countingRules.lexicalOverlap: count distinct NFKD/lowercase alphanumeric option tokens present in source context; maximum ties abstain
countingRules.absoluteTerms: \b(?:all|always|every|everyone|everything|never|only|exclusively|entirely|completely|none)\b predicts FALSE for TFNG and NO for YNNG; non-triggering statements abstain
countingRules.cyclicPosition: ordinal modulo k, reset at each source pool
countingRules.recycledDistractors: leave-one-item-out exact NFKD/lowercase alphanumeric text frequency among distractor occurrences in each reported group
countingRules.permutationInvariant: rotate left and reverse option indexes, remap answer index, and require normalized semantic key text to remain unchanged
countingRules.blanks: fill question, each formgroup blank, and each object cell in tablegroup
countingRules.multiselectPoints: selectCount; must equal qRange width and answers length
countingRules.regularMockMcq: mcq excluding exact normalized TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN and YES/NO/NOT GIVEN arrays
countingRules.structuredEvidence: valid evidenceRelation/semanticRelation plus supportingSpan(s), relatedZone+absenceTarget, or globalEvidenceScope
